notice: SIMULATION MODE — NOT FOR OPERATIONAL USE. Every value is illustrative and unreviewed. The heat strain model is a REDUCED implementation of the ISO 7933 heat-balance core, not a conformant ISO 7933 implementation, and must never be presented as one. No external body has reviewed or validated any of this.

body_mass_kg_default.rationale: Population default used when a subject body mass is absent. Heat storage per kilogram is sensitive to this, so a wrong default biases core temperature estimates.

body_surface_area_m2_default.rationale: Population default DuBois surface area. Should be computed from height and mass once those are captured per firefighter.

specific_heat_body_wh_per_kg_c.rationale: Specific heat of body tissue, used to convert stored heat into a temperature rise.

hr_max_age_constant_bpm.rationale: Constant in the age-adjusted maximum heart rate estimate (constant minus age). A crude population formula with roughly plus or minus 10 to 12 bpm individual spread, not a measured maximum.

ppe_clo.rationale: Thermal insulation of structural firefighting PPE with SCBA.

ppe_reserve_penalty_frac_per_clo.rationale: Fraction of heart rate reserve lost per clo of encapsulating PPE, representing the cardiovascular cost of wearing it. Magnitude is invented.

heat_reserve_penalty_frac_per_c.rationale: Additional fraction of heart rate reserve lost per degree of ambient temperature above the reference, representing cardiovascular drift in heat.

heat_reserve_penalty_reference_c.rationale: Ambient temperature above which the heat reserve penalty begins.

max_reserve_penalty_frac.rationale: Cap on the combined PPE and heat reserve penalty, so the model cannot claim a firefighter has almost no usable reserve.

min_hr_reserve_bpm.rationale: Floor on effective heart rate reserve, to keep the reserve fraction finite for subjects with a high resting rate.

metabolic_rate_rest_w_m2.rationale: Resting metabolic rate, one met. Lower bound of the inferred work rate.

metabolic_rate_max_w_m2.rationale: Metabolic rate at full heart rate reserve, corresponding to very heavy work. Valoris has no work-rate sensor, so metabolic rate is inferred from cardiac strain.

work_efficiency_fraction.rationale: Fraction of metabolic rate converted to external mechanical work. Near zero for firefighting tasks, so essentially all metabolism becomes heat.

skin_temp_c.rationale: Assumed mean skin temperature. ISO 7933 predicts this iteratively; holding it fixed is one of the main simplifications in this reduced model.

skin_vapour_pressure_kpa.rationale: Saturated water vapour pressure at the assumed skin temperature.

convective_coeff_w_m2k.rationale: Convective heat transfer coefficient at the reference air velocity.

radiative_coeff_w_m2k.rationale: Linearised radiative heat transfer coefficient. A linearisation is poor next to a flame front, where radiant load dominates.

air_velocity_ms_default.rationale: Air velocity assumed when none is reported. Understating velocity understates both convective loss and evaporative capacity.

air_velocity_exponent.rationale: Exponent scaling convective and evaporative transfer with air velocity.

clothing_insulation_clo_ppe.rationale: Thermal insulation used in the heat balance when PPE is worn.

clothing_insulation_clo_no_ppe.rationale: Thermal insulation used when PPE is not worn, for example during rehab.

evaporative_resistance_m2kpa_w_ppe.rationale: Evaporative resistance of structural PPE. High resistance is why sweating stops working in turnout gear, and it is the single most important number in this model.

respiratory_evaporative_coeff.rationale: Coefficient for respiratory evaporative heat loss as a function of metabolic rate and inspired vapour pressure.

respiratory_convective_coeff.rationale: Coefficient for respiratory convective heat loss as a function of metabolic rate and inspired air temperature.

max_sweat_rate_g_per_hour_unacclimatised.rationale: Maximum achievable sweat rate for an unacclimatised worker. Sweat demanded above this is simply not produced, so heat accumulates.

max_sweat_rate_g_per_hour_acclimatised.rationale: Maximum achievable sweat rate for a heat-acclimatised worker.

max_water_loss_g_unacclimatised.rationale: Cumulative water loss limit for an unacclimatised worker, one of the two limits that bound safe exposure duration.

max_water_loss_g_acclimatised.rationale: Cumulative water loss limit for a heat-acclimatised worker.

evaporative_efficiency_at_full_wettednes.rationale: Efficiency of sweat evaporation once the skin is fully wetted; the remainder drips and cools nobody. Drives the gap between required and predicted sweat rate.

phs_core_temp_limit_c.rationale: Core temperature ceiling used to compute allowable exposure duration, before personalisation for heat tolerance.

heat_tolerance_core_limit_shift_c.rationale: The allowable core temperature limit shifts down by this amount for low heat tolerance and up for high. Relaxing a limit upward is the most dangerous direction this model can move and needs physician sign-off.

dlim_horizon_min.rationale: Horizon beyond which an allowable duration is reported as not reached rather than as a very large number.

core_temp_baseline_c.rationale: Assumed starting core temperature when no prior estimate exists.

core_temp_min_c.rationale: Lower physiological bound the estimate is clamped to. The clamp is reported, so a clamped estimate is never mistaken for a measurement.

core_temp_max_c.rationale: Upper physiological bound the estimate is clamped to.

core_temp_weight_heat_storage.rationale: Weight of the heat-balance storage term in the core temperature estimate.

core_temp_weight_cardiac.rationale: Weight of the heart-rate-driven term in the core temperature estimate.

core_temp_cardiac_rise_c_per_hour_at_max.rationale: Core temperature rise per hour attributable to cardiac strain at full heart rate reserve.

core_temp_cardiac_hrr_threshold_frac.rationale: Heart rate reserve fraction below which cardiac strain contributes no net core temperature rise.

core_temp_recovery_c_per_hour.rationale: Rate at which core temperature returns toward baseline when heat storage is negative and exertion is below the threshold.

fatigue_accum_pct_per_hour_at_max_hrr.rationale: Fatigue index points accumulated per hour at full heart rate reserve, before fitness and heat multipliers.

fatigue_hrr_threshold_frac.rationale: Heart rate reserve fraction below which work is treated as recoverable rather than fatiguing.

fatigue_heat_multiplier_at_core_limit.rationale: Multiplier applied to fatigue accumulation when the estimated core temperature has reached its personalised limit.

fatigue_recovery_pct_per_hour.rationale: Fatigue index points recovered per hour below the exertion threshold. Recovery is modelled as much slower than accumulation.

fatigue_prev_shift_pct_per_hour.rationale: Fatigue index points carried into this incident per hour of the previous shift. Recovery time since that shift is not modelled.

fatigue_fitness_multiplier_low.rationale: Fatigue accumulation multiplier for low fitness.

fatigue_fitness_multiplier_moderate.rationale: Fatigue accumulation multiplier for moderate fitness.

fatigue_fitness_multiplier_high.rationale: Fatigue accumulation multiplier for high fitness.

fatigue_min_pct.rationale: Lower bound of the fatigue index.

fatigue_max_pct.rationale: Upper bound of the fatigue index.

cohb_baseline_pct.rationale: Baseline carboxyhaemoglobin for a non-smoker. Smoking status is not captured, and a smoker starts substantially higher.

cohb_pct_per_ppm_hour_at_rest.rationale: Carboxyhaemoglobin gain per ppm-hour of inhaled CO at rest. A first-order stand-in for the Coburn-Forster-Kane equation, which this model does not implement.

cohb_ventilation_multiplier_max.rationale: Multiplier on CO uptake at full heart rate reserve, representing raised minute ventilation during heavy work.

cohb_elimination_half_life_min.rationale: Carboxyhaemoglobin elimination half-life while breathing clean air. Shorter on supplemental oxygen, which is not modelled.

cohb_index_limit_pct.rationale: Carboxyhaemoglobin level treated as index 1.0. Not a safe level; a reference point for scaling only.

cohb_max_pct.rationale: Upper bound the carboxyhaemoglobin estimate is clamped to, so arithmetic stays in a physiological range.

pm25_dose_index_limit_ug_min_m3.rationale: Cumulative inhaled PM2.5 dose treated as index 1.0, for example 250 ug/m3 for 120 minutes. No occupational dose limit for wildfire smoke is settled, which is exactly why this is illustrative.

scba_inhaled_fraction_on_air.rationale: Fraction of ambient contaminant still inhaled while on air. Deliberately not zero: Valoris cannot verify mask seal, cylinder contents or compliance, so it never credits perfect protection.

scba_inhaled_fraction_off_air.rationale: Fraction of ambient contaminant inhaled when not on air.
